yt_title: Ravan Se Bhi Shaktishali Kaun Tha? | Ramayan Bhaag 1 #shorts
yt_description:
Ravan ka ant ho chuka tha. Phir Agastya rishi ne Ram ji ko kiske baare mein bataya?
Poori Ramayan, shuru se, kram mein. Roz 3 bhaag.
Aadhar: Valmiki Ramayan, Uttar kaand, sarg 1

#ramayan #pushpakkatha #shriram #meghnad #ravan #ramkatha #hindukatha #shorts
kya_aaya: Rishi Ayodhya aaye; Agastya ne kaha ki Meghnad Ravan se bhi shaktishali tha. Ram ji ne poocha kyun.
baaki: Ravan ka vansh: Pulastya rishi aur Vishrava ki katha
